candidate.rationale: The captured history contains only the qualified baseline and no candidate feedback. Choose the untried combination of both proved RTL actions at the baseline physical configuration. Exact signed 18-bit reduction may remove redundant arithmetic area and capacitance; masking multiply inputs except when accepting a request may reduce idle switching while preserving the registered cycle contract. Isolation adds gates, load and possible timing cost, so the net area-energy benefit remains unmeasured. Keep utilization 40, density 0.55, abc_area 0 and repair_margin 0 to preserve the known physical starting point without adding area-oriented mapping or repair overhead against the baseline setup slack of 0.19292 ns. Optimize Q = (cell_area_um2 / 161954) * geometric_mean(E_DOT64 / 2.293945631906608e-7, E_GEMM8 / 1.7792685987008622e-6, E_CONV3 / 1.1542462882162743e-6); die area and timing estimates do not establish improvement. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, per-workload energy_j, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score and wall costs. Require physical and measurement qualification before ranking, retain failures and costs, and retain the qualified baseline if this candidate does not improve Q. Energy interpretation remains limited to Liberty-model zero-delay post-route activity with extracted SPEF, without SDF glitch or silicon-power claims.
